The first workspace run failed one test (sync::push_isolation_tests::cancelled_push_hook_cleans_owned_descendants_but_not_interactive_sentinel) with 'hook never entered: Elapsed(())' at host load 66. It passed 3/3 in isolation (0.26s/2.77s/2.51s). Root cause was the fixture's 10s enter-budget being starved by ~1500 preceding serial tests, not a behavior regression. Repaired by introducing FIXTURE_ENTER_BUDGET (120s) for fixture *entry* waits only; production deadlines are unchanged. A negative control with the hook deliberately never signalling still FAILS the test (3.58s), so the assertion was not weakened.
